test_title: PYST 30 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Simple interest on a sum for 6 years is equal to 40 percent of the principal. In how many years interest will be equal to the principal?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) for 6 years = 40% of Principal (P)

Time (T) = 6 years

SI = P × R × T ÷ 100

**Formula Used:**

SI = P × R × T ÷ 100

Time when SI = P: T = 100 ÷ R

**Calculation:**

⇒ 40% of P = P × R × 6 ÷ 100

⇒ 40 = R × 6

⇒ R = 40 ÷ 6

⇒ R = 6.67 (approximately)

Let time when SI = P be T years:

⇒ P = P × R × T ÷ 100

⇒ 100 = R × T

⇒ T = 100 ÷ R

⇒ T = 100 ÷ 6.67

⇒ T = 15 (approximately)

**∴ The correct answer is 15 years.**
